name: Not reachable
description: robots.txt blocks shopping agents or product pages are not server-rendered.

name: Crawlable
description: Agents can fetch and read product pages.

name: Readable catalog
description: The catalog is available as data with price and availability.

name: Identifiable products
description: Sampled products carry valid identifiers that resolve across channels.

name: Trusted merchant
description: Return, shipping, privacy and terms policies are findable.

name: Transactable
description: A checkout protocol is advertised. This says the public surface is in order, not that a checkout works.
